scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && vitest run --config server/vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @wedding-suite/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @wedding-suite/shared" "npm run dev -w @wedding-suite/server" "npm run dev -w @wedding-suite/client"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names shared,client "npm run dev -w @wedding-suite/shared" "npm run dev -w @wedding-suite/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names shared,server "npm run dev -w @wedding-suite/shared" "npm run dev -w @wedding-suite/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && npm run build -w @wedding-suite/server && npm run build -w @wedding-suite/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test:client: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && vitest run --project client
scripts.test:server: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && vitest run --project server
scripts.test:shared: npm run build -w @wedding-suite/shared && vitest run --project shared
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
